title: Orphera per-VM config
description: One VM's sizing and network parameters, in the shape of the kayobe/kttb-virt-ansible per-VM file. Read by ConfigYaml.scala (--config, or config/<vm>.yaml in -c / ORPHERA_CONFIG_DIR) for the KVM provisioning and start playbooks, gen_packages, gen_dist_upgrade and the bootstrap step. Numbers that the reader takes as strings (disk, memory, cpu) are strings here too: quote them.

positiveIntegerString.description: A whole number, as a string.

disks.description: Extra data disks, in the order they are attached. The canonical entry is a one-key map, `- disk: 256` (size in GB). A bare number or string is accepted as well.

routing.description: Source routing: with table > 0 the gateway and subnet route go into that routing table, and a rule `from <ipaddress> lookup <table> priority <priority>` is added, so replies leave through this NIC.

nic0.description: The VM's first NIC, with the address it is reached on.

nic.description: The interface's name inside the guest.

cidr.description: The subnet, such as 10.10.5.0/24. Must agree with ipaddress and netmask (checked by utils/validate-schemas.py).

bridge.description: The Open vSwitch bridge on the hypervisor.

extraNic.description: A further NIC. Without an ipaddress it is brought up layer 2 only (for a Neutron provider network). Its MAC is derived from the hostname and its position, so it is stable across re-provisioning.

nic.description: The interface's name inside the guest. Default enp2s0, enp3s0, ... by position.

hypervisor.description: The inventory node that runs libvirt for this VM. Must be a node of the inventory.

hostname.description: The VM's name: its libvirt domain, and its node name in the inventory. By convention also the config file's name (config/<hostname>.yaml).

os.description: The cloud image the VM is built from, by file name.

disk.description: The system disk in GB, as a string.

memory.description: Memory in MiB, as a string.

cpu.description: Number of vCPUs, as a string.

nics.description: Further NICs, in order: the first entry is the VM's second NIC.

pdisks.description: Passthrough disks. Not implemented: the provisioning playbook warns and ignores them. Leave empty.

pre_basic_packages.description: Installed first, before the dist-upgrade (qemu-guest-agent and the like).

basic_packages.description: Installed by gen_packages after the dist-upgrade.
